items.title: Derivative-adapted BHZ tree bases eliminating nonconstant polynomial right-coaction terms under rational independence
items.difficulty_reason: H2: the canonical BHZ basis explicitly violates the basis-dependent condition D, and the old character-model theorem does not supply a basis that removes those polynomial right-coaction terms. The author introduces the multivariate binomially transformed integration operators, retains the inverse transform and strongly-conforming tree basis construction, and computes the transformed coproduct by edge induction. Regrouping the multiindex sums produces the (X-X)^beta cancellation that removes the unwanted polynomial terms while preserving the same graded tree space. The accompanying edge/node preorder and rational-independence argument verify A-C for the canonical sector. This independent coalgebra/basis construction, rather than the parameterization application or an elementary single binomial identity alone, carries the nonroutine H2 burden.
